title: A schema whose input resolves a URN INTO THE FILE THAT WILL NOT PARSE.
$comment: The URN below IS declared — by `carrier.schema.json`, textually, on its third line. The generator cannot know that, because it never read the file. This is the whole distinction `GEN_REF_UNRESOLVABLE_INDEX_INCOMPLETE` exists to draw: a derived effect, not a contract defect.
